# External methods

SpaCRAFT is compared with INSTINCT, PeakVI, scDREAMER, SEDR, STAligner, and
GraphST. Install third-party methods from their official releases in isolated
environments. This repository does not vendor entire third-party source or
notebook trees.

Reference comparison artifacts and provenance are stored under `results/`.
Add an executable wrapper only when its version, formal dataset, parameters,
and output schema are documented.
